File surface: `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/{admin-rescue-note.ts,reader-locale-labels.ts,approval-service.ts,approvals-plugin.ts}` and their tests; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-progress/ApprovalActionTimeline.tsx` and its test; `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (all 11 languages with real text, zh-Hant by the generator); changesets for `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/console`.
Container & model: `S+`, area thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening): a new optional `ApprovalServiceOptions.positionLabelSource` and new `@object-ui/i18n` keys in published declarations; nothing removed. The seat runs the L2 at the tier the final paths decide.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, main `9b3227fe`): holds. The sentence comes from `admin-rescue-note.ts`, rendered in the reader's language by `ApprovalService.localizeRoutingNotes`; the position value goes into `approvalAdminRescuePositionUnheld`'s value slot without a display-name lookup. The console's `ApprovalActionTimeline.tsx` shows a row with no `actor_id` as "—" and labels every comment row "Comment".
Basis: card #35418 (p2, epic #34571, this seat's since the maintainer's 2026-11-21 03:24:57Z order).
Scope:
1. Server, at reader render time: `position:NAME` becomes a display name, read from the reader's language pack `positions.NAME.label`, then the position's declared label (through the new optional `positionLabelSource`, which the plugin wires to the metadata service), and only then the internal name. The stored English audit comment is not changed.
2. Console: a row with no `actor_id` names its actor "System" (new key `approvalsInbox.systemActor`); a comment row with no actor is typed "System note" (new key `actSystemNote`), not "Comment". The card allows "hand-off" or "system"; the three system notes (hand to admin, submitter excluded, no approver) are not all hand-offs, so one "System note" label is used and the sentence carries the hand-off meaning. No spec contract change.
Not in scope (follow-up listed in the PR): the no-approver note's `who` part also carries an internal position name, because it is stored as an assembled string.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. L1 at L1-c (approvals). The PR carries `Fixes #35418`.
